title: Senior Content Writer ( SOP, LOR )
description:
About the company At StudyIn, we believe that the right guidance has the power to change lives. As the worlds most trusted higher education specialist, weve helped over 1.3 million students access study opportunities since 2006, placing them at top universities across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, and Dubai. Our global team of 500+ professionals spans 40+ countries worldwide, offering expert counselling, admissions support, visa guidance, and university partnerships. Main Duties & Scope of the role Review and edit personal statements, SOPs, and application essays for grammar, clarity, structure, and coherence. Ensure alignment with university guidelines and specific program expectations. Enhance content to reflect the applicant’s voice, goals, and strengths without altering authenticity. Collaborate with students or Counselors to understand background, achievements, and motivations. Provide constructive feedback to improve narrative flow and overall impact. Meet tight deadlines while maintaining high editorial standards. Key Responsibilities Edit and rewrite application documents (SOPs, essays, LORs, resumes) to highlight student strengths and individuality. Brainstorm with students to develop impactful, personalized content where needed. Ensure timely submission of assigned documents while maintaining quality. Follow standardized editing guidelines and processes. Support departmental content needs through editing, proofreading, and content creation. Assist in editing-related training and maintain quality and TAT reports. Provide personalized attention to students and uphold brand standards through quality content. About the Candidate (including required competencies) Excellent Language & Editing Skills: Proven ability to write and edit at a high level—strong command of English grammar, style, and tone. Familiarity with Admissions Processes: Solid understanding of SOP/essay structures, program requirements, and university expectations across various disciplines. Strong Interpersonal & Communication Abilities: Able to quickly build rapport with applicants, ask insightful questions to draw out their unique stories, and convey feedback constructively. Time Management & Organizational Proficiency: Experienced in juggling multiple editing projects, prioritizing tasks, and consistently meeting tight deadlines without compromising quality. Requirements & Qualification Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and engage effectively. Proven experience in developing and delivering editing-related training. Adaptable, with a proactive attitude and ability to multitask in high-pressure environments. Problem-solving mindset with a collaborative, team-oriented approach. Prior experience in the study abroad/overseas education sector preferred. Qualification: Graduate or higher; 4-5 years of relevant experience required.
